name: bounded-fp32-composition

reset.recurrent: Fresh sequence: X, K, V and y are zero, t=0. Mapal writes whole K/V formulas; explicit-reference incremental mode initializes zero K/V then updates only row t. No state survives sequences.
reset.matrix: Same immutable generated inputs and weights for each invocation; no output aliases an input.
reset.first_pass: Compiler-derived retention may compute all K/V rows on its first pass; this work difference must remain visible against explicit zero-initialized caches.

arithmetic.exact_reference: Round every scalar multiply, add and divide to binary32; dot products are left folds in increasing k/r order.
arithmetic.fma_reference: Use a real C fmaf(a,b,acc) per dot step; all other operations have the same binary32 rounding. If fmaf is unavailable, this reference is unsupported, never emulated by multiply+add.
arithmetic.status: Scalar references are not yet certified Mapal Exact/Contract oracles; frozen interpreter/CPU comparisons are required before claiming equivalence.
arithmetic.association: m=(h*Wdown)+b2 is computed before y=0.25*(p+m); do not reassociate bias/residual adds.
arithmetic.external: Parallel library/PyTorch GEMMs may reduce in another order; their numeric gate must be declared independently before timing. No TF32/autocast substitution in FP32 cases.

sources.check: Print all inputs and every intermediate checkpoint; these host observations can change placement and must not be timed as the optimized realization.
sources.run: Same equations/seeds/reset, print final full y only after all work; no intermediate host observations or time reads. Must pass final-full-output gate before any later timed variant is accepted.

admission: Larger cases require separate capacity, oracle, emitted-placement and timing-policy approval. These are synthetic dimensions, not verified full-model executions.
real_arithmetic_bound: Recurrent: if |y_previous|<=1/16 then |X|<1, |a|<=1/64, |p|<=1/256, |y|<=17/16384+3/256<0.013. Verify finite FP32 intermediates and nontrivial signals independently.
freeze: No compiler/runtime/repository source change, compiler emission, build, rental or GPU execution is performed by this preparation.
